battle.name: 合肥之戰
battle.brief: 梁天監五年（506）冬，北魏鎮東大將軍元英自壽春南下，進逼鍾離，兵鋒直指淮南樞紐合肥。梁以合肥為基地，韋叡率守軍與各州援兵馳援鍾離，曹休屯洞浦作掎角。卡面的亞述式短柄長刃鐵鏃矛，與兩軍裝備的長矛、槊同屬矛兵譜系，在騎兵衝鋒與步卒結陣中列為基本持兵。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏃。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 天監五年（506）秋冬的淮南戰線，由南北兩處重兵對峙構成：北端是梁在合肥的屯兵重鎮，南端是壽春、鍾離一線的城防。北魏方面由鎮東大將軍元英統攝大軍，自河南的洛陽、汝南一路南下，兵鋒沿壽春、合肥之間的江淮通道展開。北魏中樞在平城與洛陽，孝明帝拓跋懌在位而年幼，幽太后臨朝，軍國大事多經中樞議定再以軍令下達前線；元英可調鎮北諸軍、州郡兵以及隨軍的工匠，攻城另備撞車等器械。梁方面，梁武帝蕭衍在建康總攬大政，以護軍將軍韋叡督合肥之眾與諸州援兵西行，屯壽春、鍾離之間，另遣曹休屯於洞浦，與鍾離守軍互為掎角。合肥自州治升格為梁的北向備戰基地與軍糧轉運樞紐，郡兵、州兵、屯田卒與漕運船戶共同支撐前線。兩軍的指揮都倚重文書與符節：魏軍以軍令約束各營分節推進，梁軍則以手令與露布移報州郡，糧秣調度則憑沿途的驛傳與船籍逐程核驗。
countriesEn: The Huai River front of the winter of 506 (Tianjian 5) was formed by two concentrations of heavy troops facing each other: at the northern end stood the garrison stronghold of Hefei, and at the southern end lay the fortified line of Shouchun and Zhongli. On the Northern Wei side, General-in-Chief Yuan Ying commanded the field army, which moved south from Luoyang and Runan in Henan along the corridor between Shouchun and Hefei that connected the Yangtze and the Huai. Wei's central authority lay at Pingcheng and Luoyang: Emperor Xiaoming of Wei, Tuoba Yun, held the throne but was a child, while the empress dowager Yu governed in practice, and matters of war and state were settled in the capital and then transmitted forward as military orders. Yuan Ying could draw on the garrisons of the northern frontier, the provincial levies, the craftsmen travelling with the host and a train of ramming carts for the siege. On the Liang side, Emperor Wu of Liang, Xiao Yan, directed the war from Jiankang and entrusted Wei Rui, then Protector-General, with the troops of Hefei and the reinforcements of the various provinces, posting them westward toward Shouchun and Zhongli; Caooxiu was sent to hold Dongpu so as to act in support of the garrison of Zhongli. Hefei was raised from a mere prefectural seat to the status of Liang's forward preparation base and grain transhipment hub, and the garrison of the commandery, the provincial levies, the reclamation soldiers and the boat crews of the canal all sustained the front. Both armies ran their commands on written orders and tallies: Wei held each detachment to the advance by unit orders, Liang moved its directives between the prefectures by hand-written mandates and public circulars, and the movement of grain was checked stage by stage against the relay stations and the boat registers on the route.
people: 這場戰役在史冊上的主角，是梁的韋叡與魏的元英。韋叡字懷文，京兆杜陵人，早年隨父韋放鎮守合肥，熟悉淮北山川道里；天監初年他奉命鎮守合肥，築城浚池，積儲穀帛，把合肥修成一座可屯兵、可禦敵的堡壘。北魏大軍南下的消息傳到建康，梁武帝連下數道手令，命韋叡率合肥之眾西行赴援；韋叡部勒行伍、檢驗舟械，選用精甲，自合肥啟程，晝夜兼程而抵近戰地才令士卒宿營，既不倉皇冒進，也不使眾疲於奔命。曹休奉命屯洞浦，承擔兩翼策應，專責掩護鍾離與合肥之間的糧道，並在魏軍分兵追擊時出任反擊的一翼。北魏一線，元英自洛陽發兵，總攝大軍，先趨壽春，再進圍鍾離；此人治軍嚴整，築長圍以斷糧道，又造撞車撞擊城樓、開地道逼近城堞，攻城手段老到。北魏中樞方面，幽太后在洛陽掌握朝政，孝明帝不能親決軍機，前線勝負因此直接牽動京師的權力格局。鍾離城中的守軍則依賴城防的細節與援軍抵達的時機判斷生路；相傳城中有書生獻策，主張築地道橫截魏軍地下進攻之路，魏軍的穴進因此屢屢受挫，圍城百日而城不拔。
peopleEn: The two men the chronicles single out in this campaign are Wei Rui of Liang and Yuan Ying of Wei. Wei Rui, courtesy name Huaiwen, came from Duling in the capital district of Jingzhao; as a young man he served with his father Wei Fang in the garrison at Hefei and knew the roads and watercourses of the country north of the Huai. In the early years of the Tianjian era he was posted to command at Hefei, where he built walls, dug moats and stored grain and cloth until Hefei had become a fortress that could both quarter troops and withstand attack. When word of the Northern Wei advance reached Jiankang, Emperor Wu of Liang issued a series of written mandates ordering Wei Rui to take the troops of Hefei west to the relief of Zhongli. Wei Rui mustered his units, inspected the boats and weapons, chose his best armoured men, set out from Hefei and pushed day and night, halting the troops only when close to the battlefield, so that the host was never thrown into a disorderly rush nor exhausted by a fruitless march. Caooxiu was ordered to hold Dongpu with the task of supporting both flanks and of covering the grain road between Zhongli and Hefei, and he was the wing that struck back when Wei detached columns to pursue. On the Wei side Yuan Ying led the field army out of Luoyang, marched first on Shouchun and then closed around Zhongli. He was a strict disciplinarian who enclosed the town with a long circumvallation in order to cut its supplies, built ramming carts to batter the towers and opened tunnels to push the attack forward beneath the walls. At Wei's centre the empress dowager Yu governed from Luoyang while the child emperor could not decide military questions himself, so the result on the Huai was tied directly to the balance of power in the capital. Inside Zhongli the defenders could only judge their chances from the state of the walls and from the hour at which relief arrived; it is said that a scholar of the garrison advised the digging of a counter-tunnel across the line of the Wei miners, and the underground assault was repeatedly frustrated, so that the town held out through a hundred days of siege.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長矛是短柄、長刃、鐵鏃的形制：木柄不足五尺，刃部寬而略呈柳葉，裝在木柄之後握持重心靠前，既可用來投擲，也可在近身時橫格直刺。亞述人把它與弓、斧、盾捆在一處，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。放到梁天監五年的兩軍序列裡，同型用途的持兵主要有三種：一是南朝裝騎具裝的長柄槊，供披甲的猛士在馬上持矛衝鋒，直取敵將；二是步軍所用的長矛，與大盾結合成陣，用以抵住對方騎兵；三是北魏騎兵配備的矛與標槊，配合圓盾，衝刺時取其破甲的重量與速度。亞述矛與漢晉槊同屬「木柄加鐵鏃」的普及裝備，優點在於可以大量配給，折損之後即時補充；兩者差別在柄長與用途，亞述式短柄便於單手揮擊與投射，漢晉槊的長柄則把力矩交給馬速與騎士臂力。攻城一線另有可考的器材：魏軍用撞車撞擊城樓、以器械填堞，又開地道直進；守方用弩、排弩、弓、落石、拒馬與鹿角，壕溝與木柵構成外圍屏障。糧秣靠牛車、船舶與人力接力，合肥到鍾離一段以水運為主，稻、麥、豆與芻草沿途供應，戰馬的豆料與飲水直接關係騎兵能否投入衝鋒。
kitsEn: The Assyrian spear on the card is a short-shafted, long-bladed weapon with an iron head: the wooden shaft is under five feet, the blade is broad and rather leaf-shaped, and once socketed to the shaft the grip sits well forward, so the weapon can be thrown or used to parry and stab at close quarters. The Assyrians bundled it together with bows, axes and shields, and the cities of the river valleys fell one after another. Translated into the order of battle of the two armies in the fifth year of Tianjian, three kinds of weapon served comparable purposes. First, the long-handled mao carried by the Southern armoured cavalry, planted by fully armoured shock troops who rode with the lance to strike at enemy commanders. Second, the long spear of the infantry, combined with large shields into a solid formation used to absorb the charge of hostile horsemen. Third, the lances and javelins of the Northern Wei horse, carried with round shields, where weight and speed mattered most in the shock. The Assyrian spear and the mao of the Han and Jin belong to the same family of universal equipment: a wooden shaft with an iron head, cheap enough to issue in bulk and easy to replace when broken. The difference lies in the length of the shaft and in the task; the short Assyrian grip suits a one-handed swing or a thrown thrust, whereas the long haft of the Chinese mao leaves the leverage to the speed of the horse and the strength of the rider's arm. The siege line has its own documented equipment: the Wei besiegers used ramming carts to strike the towers, filled the breaches with timber and rubble, and drove tunnels forward under the walls; the defenders answered with crossbows, volley crossbows, bows, stones dropped from the walls, cheval-de-frise and caltrops, with ditches and wooden palisades forming the outer ring. Supplies moved by ox-cart, boat and human porters; between Hefei and Zhongli water transport predominated, with rice, wheat, beans and fodder supplied along the way, and the bean feed and watering of the warhorses directly decided whether the cavalry could be committed to a charge.
tactics: 魏軍的攻城部署是一套以斷糧為目的的長圍作戰：抵達鍾離後先劃地為營，築起環繞城池的長圍，把城內與南面的援軍隔開，再分兵撞城。城樓屢破，魏軍填堞而入，守軍靠木柵、拒馬與城上的落石、弓弩封住缺口；魏軍又掘地道逼近，試圖讓進攻從地下突破。梁軍的應對分成兩層：合肥方向保留兵員、舟船與糧秣，構成真正的支撐點；前沿則由曹休屯兵洞浦，與鍾離城形成掎角，卡住魏軍的突擊方向與糧道。韋叡率援軍抵達後並不急著正面硬撼，而是先逼近魏軍營壘，迫其分兵設防，再以小股騎兵夜襲糧車、橋柵，使魏軍無法專心攻城。決戰時，梁軍以載兵的車列正面推進，士卒持矛（卡面的亞述式短柄鐵鏃矛正屬此類近身持兵）掩護步卒衝突，配合舟師沿水路側擊，把魏軍的圍城陣形拉成三段，最後在魏軍退卻時追擊殲滅。兩軍在騎兵交鋒時都靠密集的矛陣與旗鼓號令維持節奏，結陣、突騎、投射三個動作反覆交替，這是南北朝水陸並進的典型打法。
tacticsEn: The Wei deployment before the walls was a form of siege warfare designed to starve the town rather than to storm it. On reaching Zhongli the besiegers first marked out a camp and raised a continuous circumvallation around the city, cutting it off from any relief from the south, and only then split their force to batter the walls. The towers fell again and again and the Wei filled the breaches with timber, while the defenders sealed the gaps with palisades, cheval-de-frise, stones dropped from above and the fire of their bows and crossbows. The besiegers also drove tunnels forward, trying to bring the assault up from beneath the ground. Liang's answer worked on two levels. Hefei retained the troops, the boats and the grain, and was the real support of the whole operation; on the forward line Caooxiu's men at Dongpu formed the pivot of a pincer with the garrison of Zhongli, closing the direction of the Wei thrust and the grain road behind it. Wei Rui, once his relief column had arrived, did not engage in a head-on collision; he first closed on the Wei camp to force the enemy to spread its strength into separate defences, and then sent small bodies of horse at night against the grain wagons and the bridge barricades, so that the besiegers could not concentrate on the walls. In the decisive action the Liang column advanced behind a wheeled front of soldiers, the foot troops covered by spearmen - the short-shafted iron-headed Assyrian spear on the card belongs to exactly this class of close-quarter arm - and the flotilla struck along the waterway, tearing the Wei siege line into three parts; when the besiegers finally withdrew, they were destroyed in the pursuit. In the clash of horse, both sides held their rhythm with dense spear formations and the beating of drums and flags, cycling through three actions in turn: close the formation, charge home, throw. This was the standard way of fighting of the northern and southern courts, land and water moving together.
data: 關於兵數，兩朝史冊都只用概數。北魏方面，時人稱元英所統大軍「十餘萬」，但這類數目往往把隨軍工匠、輜重夫役與各路州郡兵一併計入，實際作戰兵力當然低於此數；鍾離被圍的時間，記為自十月起至翌年二月城破，前後約百日。韋叡所部由合肥出發，兵員數史無明載，只記其「率合肥之眾」及諸州援兵，總數當在數萬之譜。城本身的尺度有明確記載：鍾離城周十餘里，東北隅因水而曲，築城時的取土坑使城防格外吃重。魏軍的攻城器械與工程也留下時間痕跡：撞車破樓、填堞、開地道都集中在圍城後期，說明器械是逐次投入，而非一開始即全面展開。戰果方面，梁朝史官記載魏軍在撤退途中被追擊斬獲萬計、屍首填塞江淮，數字明顯帶有修辭成分；較為可靠的是曹休一部在洞浦方向擊破魏軍追騎，以及韋叡部在鍾離城下破魏營之後追擊潰兵。傷亡方面，雙方史書都只給出「死者數萬」一類的概括，未留下可核對的名冊。
dataEn: On the numbers, both courts' histories give only approximations. For the Northern Wei side, contemporaries said that the army under Yuan Ying numbered something over a hundred thousand, but such figures habitually included the craftsmen, the baggage porters and the provincial levies drawn from many districts, so the actual fighting force must have been considerably lower. The blockade of Zhongli is dated from the tenth month until the fall of the town in the second month of the following year, a siege of roughly a hundred days. Wei Rui's host set out from Hefei, and no muster figure survives for it; the record only says that he took the troops of Hefei together with the reinforcements of the various provinces, so the total can only be put at several tens of thousands. The size of the town itself is recorded: Zhongli's wall ran a circuit of more than ten li, and the north-eastern corner bent with the water, with the borrow-pits dug during its construction making the defence unusually hard to work. The besieging equipment and engineering leave a visible trace in the sequence of the siege: the ramming of the towers, the filling of the breaches and the tunnels were concentrated in the later phase, which shows that the heavy equipment was fed in step by step rather than committed all at once. As for the results, Liang's official historians record that the Wei army was cut down by the thousands during the pursuit and that the dead filled the river and the marsh; such figures plainly carry a rhetorical charge. The better grounded items are Caooxiu's men breaking the Wei pursuit on the Dongpu side and Wei Rui's troops pursuing the broken host after breaking the Wei camp below Zhongli. On casualties, the records of both sides give only general formulations such as several tens of thousands dead, and no roll can be checked.
cause: 北魏的南下，是南方政權更替後立刻出現的邊境試探。天監四年（505）梁武帝即位未久，內部正忙於裁撤齊代冗官、整頓州郡與收攏新附之地，淮南防務只由韋叡在合肥修城備戰一事維持；北魏則在孝明帝與幽太后主政之下國力轉強，平城與六鎮的兵源、洛陽的糧秣都足以支出一場大規模戰役。天監五年，魏軍在完成對青、兗、豫州的調動之後由汝南、壽春方向推進，取道正是合肥所在的江淮通道——這條線上，壽春是北上的節點，合肥則是唯一同時握有城池、水路與大片屯田的據點，一旦合肥失守，鍾離與建康之間就再無屏障。梁軍的出兵同樣帶有反制性質：若任由魏軍攻下鍾離，魏騎便可沿淮水東下，淮南諸郡將逐個暴露。史家常把這場戰役的起因歸結為北魏「欲平江南」的長期目標，並指出它與北魏中樞幽太后、孝明帝及權臣之間的權力角力有關，但直接觸發點並不抽象：魏軍南下的時機、方向與集結地點，都可以在壽春與合肥的糧秣線上看得很清楚。
causeEn: The Northern Wei advance was a probe of the frontier that followed immediately upon a change of dynasty in the south. In 505, shortly after Xiao Yan had taken the throne, the Liang government was absorbed in dismissing the redundant officials of the Qi house, reorganising the prefectures and settling the newly submitted territories, and the defence of the Huai was kept in hand by nothing more than Wei Rui's work on the walls of Hefei. Northern Wei, meanwhile, was growing strong under Emperor Xiaoming and the empress dowager Yu: the manpower of Pingcheng and the northern garrisons and the grain of Luoyang could both support a campaign on a large scale. In the fifth year of Tianjian, having moved the troops of the Qing, Yan and Yu provinces, the Wei army advanced from Runan and Shouchun, and the road it took was precisely the corridor of the Yangtze and Huai that Hefei commands. On that line Shouchun was the stepping stone northward, while Hefei was the only point that held a walled city, a water route and extensive reclaimed fields at once; if Hefei fell, nothing would stand between Zhongli and Jiankang. Liang's dispatch carried a counter-purpose of its own: had Wei been allowed to take Zhongli, the Wei horse could have ridden east down the Huai and laid open the commanderies of the region one after another. Historians have commonly traced the origin of this campaign to the long-standing Wei aim of bringing the south under rule, and have linked it to the struggle for power between the empress dowager, the child emperor and the leading ministers at the Wei court. The immediate trigger, however, was nothing so abstract: the timing, the direction and the place of assembly of the invading army can all be read off the grain route between Shouchun and Hefei.
impact: 合肥與鍾離兩處沒有淪陷，意味著北魏整個南下的企圖被壓回淮北。梁得以繼續保有合肥作為淮東跳板，把壽春、合肥、鍾離連成一條可以互相策應的防線；此後韋叡鎮雍州、曹休鎮揚州，淮南的守備編制便被固定下來，直到侯景之亂才被徹底打散。對北魏而言，這是一場難得的敗仗：元英的圍城戰術被證明無法在糧道被切斷的條件下收束，士卒疲於攻城而不得食，撤退一旦被追擊就立刻崩潰；元英此後再攻鍾離又遭挫敗，聲望重挫，北魏在江淮的攻勢自此收束。對南朝而言，此役鞏固了梁武帝以守禦換時間的國策，也讓韋叡一系的將領集團站穩腳跟，江南在器械、屯田與城防上的經驗在此後十數年的南梁對魏戰爭中被反覆引用。合肥從此不再只是州治，而是被寫入南朝北防的敘述之中，成為「守江必守淮」這條經驗法則所指的具體地名。
impactEn: Because neither Hefei nor Zhongli fell, the whole of the Wei design in the south was pushed back to the north bank of the Huai. Liang was able to keep Hefei as its foothold east of the river and to link Shouchun, Hefei and Zhongli into a single line in which the three positions could support one another; in the years that followed, with Wei Rui posted to Yongzhou and Caooxiu to Yangzhou, the structure of the Huai defence became fixed, and it was not broken apart for good until the rebellion of Hou Jing. For Northern Wei it was an unusual defeat. The siege methods of Yuan Ying were shown to be unworkable once the supply line was cut: men exhausted by assault went hungry, and the moment the retreat began the army came apart under pursuit. Yuan Ying's later attempt on Zhongli failed as well, his reputation suffered badly, and the Wei offensive on the Huai was brought to a close. For the southern court the campaign confirmed the policy of Emperor Wu of Liang, which was to buy time through defence, and it established the standing of the circle of commanders around Wei Rui; the experience of the south in siegecraft, land reclamation and fortification was cited again and again in the wars Liang fought against Wei over the following decade and more. Hefei ceased to be a prefectural seat alone and entered the narrative of southern northern defence by name, becoming the concrete place to which the rule of thumb that one who guards the river must guard the Huai points.
result: 圍城百日，魏軍終未能攻下鍾離：撞車破樓之後仍補不回缺口，地道被橫溝截斷，長圍之外的糧道又被曹休與韋叡兩部輪番打擊，軍中乏食。梁軍在韋叡的指揮下先以車列與舟師壓迫魏營，再在魏軍退卻時全線出擊，魏軍在江淮之間崩潰，屍首蔽野；被圍的鍾離守軍趁勢出城，與援軍合為一體。魏軍退回壽春，收攏殘部，北魏在江淮的攻勢就此中止，淮南暫時安定。梁軍自身折損相對有限，因為城防得全而援軍先至；史書記曹休部與韋叡部的斬獲以萬計，多有誇飾。戰後韋叡因功遷車騎將軍、加封都陽侯，並獲賞車馬器物；曹休亦同受封賞，合肥、鍾離的城防與屯田一併加厚，軍械重新補給。對北魏而言，此役是一次清楚的失敗預警：任何再往江南的計畫，都必須先解決「攻堅而糧不足」這個老問題。
resultEn: After a hundred days the Wei army had not taken Zhongli. The towers had been battered down, yet the breaches could not be made good; the tunnels were cut across by a ditch; the supply route outside the circumvallation was harried again and again by the two columns of Caooxiu and Wei Rui; and the besiegers went hungry. Under Wei Rui's command the Liang force first pressed the Wei camp with a wheeled front and the flotilla, and then struck along the whole line as the besiegers withdrew, and the Wei army came apart between the river and the marsh with the dead covering the ground. The besieged garrison of Zhongli sallied out and joined the relief force, and the Wei retreated to Shouchun to gather up the remnants, ending the Wei offensive on the Huai and settling the region for the time being. Liang's own losses were comparatively light, because the walls held and the relief arrived first; the accounts of the thousands of enemies cut down by the columns of Caooxiu and Wei Rui are plainly exaggerated. After the campaign Wei Rui was advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry and ennobled as Marquis of Duyang, with gifts of horses and weapons, and Caooxiu was rewarded in the same fashion; the fortifications and reclaimed fields of Hefei and Zhongli were reinforced together, and the arms and armour were replenished. For Northern Wei the campaign was an unmistakable warning: any further plan to move into the south would first have to solve the old problem of assaulting a wall while running short of food.
